summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun v1.3.13 release, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes the sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly downloaded Bun runtime via execFileSync. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle carrying obfuscator-style string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()) }`), a large mixed numeric/string constant array, and hex-mangled identifiers. The package's advertised purpose is a React feature-gate library that has no need for a second language runtime or for a multi-hundred-KB obfuscated blob. Using an alternate runtime to execute the obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based install-time inspection and runs attacker-controlled code on any machine that runs `npm install` against this version. Version 1.11.4 also introduces this behavior for the first time — CHANGELOG.md's last entry is v1.11.3, package.json `author` is empty, and prior versions contain neither the preinstall hook, nor setup.mjs, nor math_init.js — consistent with a compromised release under an existing scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
